Branch created by Claude to fill out GitHub profile README with personal bio
Branch containing full SmartSphere Shopify homepage theme (18 files across 7 directories)

Personal profile bio — currently working on open-source projects; learning distributed systems / ML / cloud-native; open to collaborating on dev-productivity tools; skills: Python / system design / backend engineering; fun fact: hiking & software architecture parallels
Default GitHub profile README template with commented-out placeholder prompts (unfilled)
Root Shopify layout — includes <head> meta tags, font imports (Inter + Poppins), CSS/JS asset links, navigation header with cart icon, footer, and scroll-reveal init

Main stylesheet — design system: dark navy (#060b18) base with electric-cyan / purple / gold accent palette; CSS custom properties; full responsive layout (1280px → mobile); animations: scroll-reveal / floating cards / particle canvas / progress bars / globe pings / infinite scroll marquee

Main JS — IntersectionObserver scroll-reveal; animated counting for stats; particle canvas animation (hero background); typewriter / typing-effect for hero tagline; filterable product grid; cart icon badge; smooth scrolling; mobile nav toggle

Hero section — animated particle canvas background; typing-effect tagline; headline + subheadline; dual CTA buttons (Shop Now / Learn More); floating live-dashboard widget card with metric stats; Shopify schema settings for headline / subheadline / CTA text & links

Infinite-scroll trust bar — duplicated marquee of trust badges: star rating (4.9/5 · 50k+ reviews) / Free Global Shipping / Secure Checkout / AI-Powered / ISO Certified; CSS animation for seamless left-scroll loop

Features grid — 6 feature cards (AI-Powered / Global Reach / Smart Analytics / Instant Delivery / Secure & Private / 24/7 Support); animated skill-style progress bars for 4 AI productivity metrics; schema-controlled section heading

Filterable product grid — category tabs (All / Smart Home / Productivity / Wearables / AI Tools); renders Shopify collection products using product-card snippet; JS-powered filter; schema settings for collection & heading
Global reach section — pulsing animated globe SVG with location ping dots; 4 animated counter stats (150+ Countries / 2M+ Users / 99.9% Uptime / 50k+ Products); schema-controlled heading

Services section — 6 service cards with icons: Smart Setup / Tech Consulting / SmartCare Protection / Enterprise Solutions / Trade-In Program / SmartSphere Academy; hover-lift card animations; schema-controlled heading
Task management showcase section — live animated task list UI widget demonstrating SmartSphere productivity; text content alongside interactive task card; schema-controlled heading & description

Testimonials section — 6 customer reviews from Japan / Canada / Nigeria / Portugal / India / Germany; star ratings; avatar initials; country flags via emoji; auto-scroll or grid layout; schema-controlled heading
Newsletter signup section — Shopify native customer newsletter form integration; email input + submit; schema settings for heading / subheading / button label
Reusable product card component — renders product image / title / price / compare-at price / discount badge / Add-to-Cart button; used by featured-products section

Homepage template — Shopify Online Store 2.0 JSON template defining section order and default settings: hero → trust-strip → features → featured-products → global-reach → services → task-showcase → testimonials → newsletter
Theme settings schema — defines customisable theme-level options (colours / typography / social links) visible in Shopify Theme Customiser admin panel
Saved theme settings data — stores current values of settings_schema options for the active theme preset
Default English translation strings — internationalisation (i18n) keys for all section labels / button text / accessibility strings used across the SmartSphere theme
